name: opapp-api
description: OPAPP API – Cloudflare Worker + D1, trackt Allzeithochs & Kursverlauf der OPShards-Wechselkurse sowie den Spieler-Rekord (All-Time & Tages-Peak) des Servers.

scripts.db:ath: wrangler d1 execute opapp-shards --remote --command="SELECT * FROM all_time_high;"
scripts.db:peak: wrangler d1 execute opapp-shards --remote --command="SELECT * FROM player_count_peak;"
scripts.db:peak-today: wrangler d1 execute opapp-shards --remote --command="SELECT * FROM daily_peak ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 14;"
